diagnosis_and_fix.fix_summary: Added exported minimal transport diagnosis predicate isTransientNetworkChangedProbeFailure(evidence) in scripts/probe-hosted-browser-bff.mjs that checks that BFF failures exist and all BFF/console failures are net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED without requiring response-dependent flags (anonymousAuthBoundaryVerified, requiredCoreResponseOk, observedProtectedResponsesOk) to already be true on attempt 1 when ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED prevents observing the first core/auth response, while still rejecting any non-ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED BFF/console/page/resource/policy/write/secret/auth error and keeping the second full probe authoritative. Updated run_release_probe in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh so pre-switch phases (*_pre_switch) allow at most one complete re-probe with identical identities before switch, preserving attempt-1 evidence at browser-probe-<phase>-attempt-1.json and browser.probe.<phase>.attempt_1=failed distinct from final browser-probe-<phase>.json and browser.probe.<phase>.
